description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref: P1412.24 dated 23/12/2024 to allow for Minor amendment to external flank facade from red brick to grey brick finish - the immediate vicinity has a multitude of external finishes from mable clad, aluminium, painted stripes and tiles so we see this minor colour amendment to the natural brick in keeping with the overall area and original application approval. (Single storey side extension with Class E use)
decision_conditions: The requested non-material amendment to planning permission P1412.24 dated 23/12/2024 to allow for amendment to the materials are considered to materially affect the character and nature of the development previously approved and cannot be regarded as a non-material amendment as the change would alter the appearance of the development in design terms and its contribution to the wider street scene and the building it would be connected to.
The submission of a fresh planning application is therefore deemed necessary in this case.
